contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [--]MAGN[---]AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Magnentius (350-353), two Victories issue of 351-353, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Head probably draped and diademed right; possibly A in left field. Obverse inscription: [--]MAGN[---]AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories holding wreath inscribed VOT/V/MVLT/X. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES]. Diameter: 17.3mm, Weight: 1.50gms, die axis: 6
